answer: Problem: sybil swarms mint disposable keys and lace them through an opal invite graph that floods peer matching. Mechanism: each claim posts a trellis-bound stake H(pk||epoch||lane) and must clear two timed work proofs on distinct lane digests at least forty minutes apart. Cost: a missed proof burns the stake and locks that key out of matching for five epochs. Verification: peers recompute the trellis hash against the public lane log and drop duplicate key clusters. Failure: recycled stakes or forged garden proofs zero attestation weight for that claim.
